Eight comments

Composed by jowan merckx

I got the original scores from jowan himself, and put it here on the db with his permission. flook’s version is somewhat different in that they only play parts A, B and C with a slight variation to the original, which doesn’t take anything away from this tune’s quality.
i’ll post the flook version as well.
